svg.title: 时序证据、多模态核查与媒体 Infra · 片段模型适配、时序解析与多模态核查
svg.desc: 片段分类和关键要素样本适配辅助模型，量化后部署到 vLLM / Docker，为口播与画面文字处理提供分类和要素抽取能力。FFmpeg、ASR / OCR 与片段索引保持同一时间轴，LangGraph 调用独立的 qwen3.6-397b 多模态 API 核查冲突，并通过持久化状态、证据报告和 Langfuse 保留执行依据。；片段样本与媒体接入：Annotated Segment Dataset，Clip / Transcript / Domain Labels，Risk Class / Entity / Time Range，Source-separated Train / Holdout；Video Task Queue，Python / Celery / Redis，Window ID / Retry / Idempotency；任务适配与媒体处理：Segment Extraction Fine-tuning，PyTorch / PEFT / LoRA / QLoRA，Domain Terms / Segment Class / Entities，Adapter / Segment Recall Regression；FFmpeg Media Worker，Docker / FFmpeg，Window Slicing / Frame Sampling，Audio Tracks / Segment Timestamps；qwen3.6-397b API，Multimodal API / HTTPX，Frame / Speech / Product Comparison，Concurrency Limit / Request Budget；量化产物与时序核查：Segment Model Quantization，AWQ / GPTQ / Clip Calibration，Quantized Weights / Tokenizer，Entity / Risk Recall Regression；Speech / Frame Text Worker，ASR / OCR / Python，Timestamped Transcript / Frame Text，Segment Classification / Entity Extraction；Temporal Evidence Index，Object Storage / Segment ID，Start / End / Frame / Transcript，Product Context / Source URI；LangGraph Audit Graph，StateGraph / Conditional Routing，Segment Context / Regulatory Skills，Cross-modal Evidence Aggregation；辅助推理与证据交付：Segment Inference Service，vLLM / Docker / Quantized Model，Clip Batching / Extraction Endpoint，Model Version / Worker Capacity；Temporal Evidence Report，Risk / Rule / Segment Citation，Frame / Transcript / Product Evidence，React / Reviewable Media Links；Graph Persistence & Trace，PostgreSQL / Checkpointer / thread_id，Checkpoint / Resume / Segment State，Langfuse / Node Latency / Model Usage；01 Annotated Segment Dataset → Segment Extraction Fine-tuning：片段类别、领域口播与要素抽取监督样本；02 Video Task Queue → FFmpeg Media Worker：按窗口派发媒体解析任务；03 Segment Extraction Fine-tuning → Segment Model Quantization：适配权重与独立片段样本校准；04 Segment Model Quantization → Segment Inference Service：通过片段召回与要素回归的量化模型；05 FFmpeg Media Worker → Speech / Frame Text Worker：带时间戳的音轨与抽样画面；06 Speech / Frame Text Worker ↔ Segment Inference Service：片段分类 / 领域要素抽取请求与结果；07 Speech / Frame Text Worker → Temporal Evidence Index：口播、画面文字、分类与原始时间位置；08 Temporal Evidence Index → LangGraph Audit Graph：按片段对齐的核查上下文；09 LangGraph Audit Graph ↔ qwen3.6-397b API：多模态核查请求 / 跨载体冲突结果；10 LangGraph Audit Graph ↔ Graph Persistence & Trace：图状态保存 / 断点恢复 / 调用记录；11 LangGraph Audit Graph → Temporal Evidence Report：风险判断与原始片段证据
